## c

*n.* 1. **攝氏度** — a degree on the centigrade scale of temperature
2. **光速** — the speed at which light travels in a vacuum; the constancy and universality of the speed of light is recognized by defining it to be exactly 299,792,458 meters per second
3. **脫氧胞苷酸** — one of the four nucleotides used in building DNA; all four nucleotides have a common phosphate group and a sugar (ribose)
4. **胞嘧啶** — a base found in DNA and RNA and derived from pyrimidine; pairs with guanine
5. **碳** — an abundant nonmetallic tetravalent element occurring in three allotropic forms: amorphous carbon and graphite and diamond; occurs in all organic compounds
6. **一百** — ten 10s
*adj.* 1. **一百, 百, 百個, 許多+的** — being ten more than ninety

3. a list or register of events (appointments or social events or court cases etc)

## call

**發音：** /kɔːl/
*v.* 1. **取名, 命名, 稱為, 叫** — assign a specified (usually proper) proper name to
*“They named their son David”*
*“The new school was named after the famous Civil Rights leader”*
2. **打電話, 電話, 呼叫, 召集** — get or try to get into communication (with someone) by telephone
*“I tried to call you all night”*
*“Take two aspirin and call me in the morning”*
3. **叫, 喊, 大叫, 叫喊, 呼喊** — utter a sudden loud cry
*“she cried with pain when the doctor inserted the needle”*
*“I yelled to her from the window but she couldn't hear me”*
4. **召喚, 呼叫, 徵召** — order, request, or command to come
*“She was called into the director's office”*
*“Call the police!”*
5. **拜訪** — pay a brief visit
*“The mayor likes to call on some of the prominent citizens”*
6. **召集** — call a meeting; invite or command to meet
*“The Wannsee Conference was called to discuss the `Final Solution'”*
*“The new dean calls meetings every week”*
*n.* 1. **電話聯繫, 電話聯絡, 電話** — a telephone connection
*“she reported several anonymous calls”*
*“he placed a phone call to London”*
2. **叫喊, 叫聲, 吆喝, 喊叫, 喊聲** — a loud utterance; often in protest or opposition
*“the speaker was interrupted by loud cries from the rear of the audience”*
3. **鳥叫聲, 鳥語** — the characteristic sound produced by a bird
*“a bird will not learn its song unless it hears it at an early age”*
4. **短暫的拜訪** — a brief social visit
*“senior professors' wives no longer make afternoon calls on newcomers”*
*“the characters in Henry James' novels are forever paying calls on each other, usually in the parlor of some residence”*
5. *(countable, uncountable)* **呼叫, 呼喊** — A cry or shout.
6. *(countable, uncountable)* **通話 /通話, 電話 /電話** — A telephone conversation; a phone call.

**發音：** /ˈkæl.vɪ.nɪ.zəm/
*n.* 1. *(countable, uncountable)* **加爾文主義 /加爾文主義** — The Christian religious tradition based upon the doctrines and forms of Christian practice of several Protestant reformers, especially John Calvin, in contrast to Catholicism, Lutheranism, Anabaptism, and Arminianism. *n.* 1. *(Internet)* **驗證碼 /驗證碼** — A computerized test requiring the human user to perform a task deemed to be difficult to automate, such as entering a displayed series of distorted characters or describing images, to demonstrate that they are a human and not a computer program.

<a id="entry-c-000970"></a>
## caption

**發音：** /ˈkæp.ʃən/
*n.* 1. **標題 /標題** — The descriptive heading or title, of a document or part thereof.
2. **字幕** — A piece of text appearing on screen as a subtitle or other part of a film or broadcast, describing dialogue (and sometimes other sound) for viewers who cannot hear.
3. **說明文字** — brief description accompanying an illustration
4. taking exception; especially a quibble based on a captious argument

5. translation of foreign dialogue of a movie or TV program; usually displayed at the bottom of the screen
*v.* 1. **加上標題, 加上說明** — provide with a caption, as of a photograph or a drawing

## capture

**發音：** /ˈkæp.(t)ʃəː/
*v.* 1. **使著迷, 使迷人, 使迷戀, 著迷, 迷住** — attract; cause to be enamored
*“She captured all the men's hearts”*
2. **抓取, 捕獲, 獲得** — bring about the capture of an elementary particle or celestial body and causing it enter a new orbit
*“This nucleus has captured the slow-moving neutrons”*
*“The star captured a comet”*
3. **佔領, 奪取** — take possession of by force, as after an invasion
*“the invaders seized the land and property of the inhabitants”*
*“The army seized the town”*
4. **捕, 捕捉, 抓, 抓住, 捕獲** — capture as if by hunting, snaring, or trapping
*“I caught a rabbit in the trap today”*
5. *(transitive)* **捕獲 /捕獲, 佔領 /佔領** — To take control of; to seize by force or stratagem.
6. *(transitive)* **碌** — To store (as in sounds or image) for later revisitation.
*n.* 1. **俘獲, 捕獲** — a process whereby a star or planet holds an object in its gravitational field
2. *(countable, uncountable)* **捕獲 /捕獲, 佔領 /佔領** — An act of capturing; a seizing by force or stratagem.
3. **俘獲, 捕獲** — any process in which an atomic or nuclear system acquires an additional particle
4. the act of forcibly dispossessing an owner of property
5. the act of taking of a person by force
6. the removal of an opponent's piece from the chess board

*“The jar carries wine”*

*“carry too far”*

## case

**發音：** /keɪs/
*n.* 1. **場合, 實例, 情況, 例子, 事例** — an occurrence of something
*“it was a case of bad judgment”*
*“another instance occurred yesterday”*
2. **情況, 狀況** — a special set of circumstances
*“in that event, the first possibility is excluded”*
*“it may rain in which case the picnic will be canceled”*
3. **官司, 案, 案件, 訟案, 訴訟案** — a comprehensive term for any proceeding in a court of law whereby an individual seeks a legal remedy
*“the family brought suit against the landlord”*
4. **框子** — a portable container for carrying several objects
*“the musicians left their instrument cases backstage”*
5. **實驗品, 白老鼠, 監視對象** — a person who is subjected to experimental or other observational procedures; someone who is an object of investigation
*“the subjects for this investigation were selected randomly”*
*“the cases that we studied were drawn from two different communities”*
6. **一箱子** — the quantity contained in a case
*v.* 1. **踩點** — look over, usually with the intention to rob
*“They men cased the housed”*
2. enclose in, or as if in, a case
*“my feet were encased in mud”*

**發音：** /ˈkæʃ/
*n.* 1. **硬通貨, 現款** — money in the form of bills or coins
*“there is a desperate shortage of hard cash”*
2. *(uncountable, usually)* **現錢 /現錢, 現金 /現金, 現款 /現款** — Money in the form of notes or bills and coins, as opposed to checks, credit or electronic transactions.
3. *(historical)* **方孔錢 /方孔錢, 銅錢 /銅錢, 銅幣 /銅幣** — The low-denomination coin of southern India until 1818.
4. **即時付款** — prompt payment for goods or services in currency or by check
5. United States country music singer and songwriter (1932-2003)
*v.* 1. **兌換現款** — exchange for cash
*“I cashed the check as soon as it arrived in the mail”*

*n.* 1. **現金墊款, 預付款** — an amount paid before it is earned

## cash basis

*n.* 1. **現金制** — a method of accounting in which each item is entered as payments are received or made
2. *(attributive, often, uncountable)* **現金收付制 /現金收付制** — A method of accounting that tracks income and expenditure when they actually occur, rather than when they become due.

*n.* 1. **現金卡** — a credit card that entitles the holder to receive cash

2. a project that generates a continuous flow of money

**發音：** /sɪˈlɛs.ti.əl/
*adj.* 1. **天+的, 天上+的** — of or relating to the sky
*“celestial map”*
*“a heavenly body”*
2. **天國+的** — relating to or inhabiting a divine heaven
*“celestial beings”*
*“heavenly hosts”*
3. *(not-comparable, usually)* **天的, 天空的** — Of, relating to, or located in the sky or outer space, where the Sun, Moon, planets, and stars are visible.
4. of heaven or the spirit
*“celestial peace”*
*“ethereal melodies”*

<a id="entry-c-002020"></a>
## celestial body

*n.* 1. **天體 /天體, 星體 /星體, 星球** — A natural object which is located outside of Earth's atmosphere, such as a comet, an asteroid, the Moon, a planet, the Sun, or a star.
2. natural objects visible in the sky

<a id="entry-c-002021"></a>
## Celestial Empire

*prop. n.* 1. **天朝** — The Empire of China.

<a id="entry-c-002022"></a>
## celestial equator

*n.* 1. **天球赤道** — A great circle on the celestial sphere, coincident with the plane of Earth's Equator.
2. the great circle on the celestial sphere midway between the celestial poles

<a id="entry-c-002023"></a>
## celestial globe

*n.* 1. **渾天儀** — a globe that is a spherical model of the heavens

<a id="entry-c-002024"></a>
## celestial orbit

*n.* 1. **天體軌道, 軌道** — the (usually elliptical) path described by one celestial body in its revolution about another
*“he plotted the orbit of the moon”*

<a id="entry-c-002025"></a>
## celestial sphere

*n.* 1. **天球** — The apparent outer limit of space; an abstract sphere of infinite radius which serves as the imaginary backdrop for celestial objects, and of which the visible sky is one hemisphere.
2. the apparent surface of the imaginary sphere on which celestial bodies appear to be projected

## cell

**發音：** /sɛl/
*n.* 1. **細胞** — (biology) the basic structural and functional unit of all organisms; they may exist as independent units of life (as in monads) or may form colonies or tissues as in higher plants and animals
2. **電池** — a device that delivers an electric current as the result of a chemical reaction
3. **大哥大, 手提電話, 手機, 移動電話, 蜂窩式移動電話** — a hand-held mobile radiotelephone for use in an area divided into small sections, each with its own short-range transmitter/receiver
4. *(Australia, India, New-Zealand)* **手機 /手機, 大哥大** — A cellular phone.
5. **和尚或尼姑的生活的小房間** — small room in which a monk or nun lives
6. **牢房** — a room where a prisoner is kept

<a id="entry-c-002035"></a>
## cell body

*n.* 1. **細胞體 /細胞體** — A cell of a unicellular organism, constituting its entire body.

<a id="entry-c-002036"></a>
## cell cycle

*n.* 1. **細胞週期 /細胞週期** — The life cycle of eukaryotic cells from a quiescent beginning, growth, duplication of DNA followed by mitosis and division.

<a id="entry-c-002037"></a>
## cell division

*n.* 1. *(countable, uncountable)* **細胞分裂** — a process by which a cell divides into two cells
2. **細胞分裂** — the process in reproduction and growth by which a cell divides to form daughter cells

<a id="entry-c-002038"></a>
## cell group

*n.* 1. **細胞群 /細胞群** — A collection of cells that work together to perform a specific, coordinated function within a multicellular organism.
2. **細胞小組 /細胞小組** — A Christian religious group that meets to study the Bible, usually in a member's home.

<a id="entry-c-002039"></a>
## cell line

*n.* 1. **細胞系 /細胞系** — A biological tissue or group of individual cells that are genetically identical as a result of dividing mitotically from a single progenitor cell.

<a id="entry-c-002040"></a>
## cell membrane

*n.* 1. **細胞膜 /細胞膜** — The semipermeable membrane that surrounds the cytoplasm of a cell.
2. a thin membrane (a double layer of lipids) enclosing the cytoplasm of a cell; proteins in the membrane control passage of ions (like sodium or potassium or calcium) in and out of the cell
*“all cells have a cell membrane”*

<a id="entry-c-002041"></a>
## cell phone

*v.* 1. **用手機呼叫** — call up by using a cellular phone
*“If the train is late, I will cell phone you”*

<a id="entry-c-002042"></a>
## cell wall

**發音：** /sɛl wɔːl/
*n.* 1. **細胞壁 /細胞壁** — A rigid, non-living structural layer located outside the cell membrane in certain cells, such as those of plants, fungi, bacteria, and some algae, providing support, shape, and protection.
2. a rigid layer of polysaccharides enclosing the membrane of plant and prokaryotic cells; maintains the shape of the cell and serves as a protective barrier

## certain

**發音：** /ˈsɜː.tən/
*adj.* 1. **一定+的, 不容爭辯+的, 不容懷疑, 無疑+的, 確切+的** — having or feeling no doubt or uncertainty; confident and assured

*“his fate is sealed”*

## chance

**發音：** /t͡ʃɑːns/ [t͡ʃʰɑːns]
*n.* 1. **機會** — a possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances
*“the holiday gave us the opportunity to visit Washington”*
*“now is your chance”*
2. **僥倖, 偶然性, 運氣, 機會** — an unknown and unpredictable phenomenon that causes an event to result one way rather than another
*“bad luck caused his downfall”*
*“we ran into each other by pure chance”*
3. **冒險, 風險, 危險** — a risk involving danger
*“you take a chance when you let her drive”*
4. **概率, 幾率, 或然性, 可能性** — a measure of how likely it is that some event will occur; a number expressing the ratio of favorable cases to the whole number of cases possible
*“the probability that an unbiased coin will fall with the head up is 0.5”*
5. *(countable)* **幾率 /幾率, 概率, 可能性** — The probability of something happening.
6. **或然性, 有前途, 可能性** — the possibility of future success
*“his prospects as a writer are excellent”*
*adj.* 1. occurring or appearing or singled out by chance
*“seek help from casual passers-by”*
*“a casual meeting”*
*v.* 1. **偶然發生, 碰巧** — be the case by chance
*“I chanced to meet my old friend in the street”*
2. **冒險, 賭博, 孤注一擲** — take a risk in the hope of a favorable outcome
*“When you buy these stocks you are gambling”*
3. **巧遇, 碰巧, 偶然發現** — come upon, as if by accident; meet with
*“We find this idea in Plato”*
*“I happened upon the most wonderful bakery not very far from here”*

<a id="entry-c-002575"></a>

*n.* 1. **偶然, 意外** — anything that happens suddenly or by chance without an apparent cause
*“winning the lottery was a happy accident”*
*“the pregnancy was a stroke of bad luck”*

## change

**發音：** /ˈt͡ʃeɪnd͡ʒ/
*v.* 1. **引起變化, 修改, 改變** — cause to change; make different; cause a transformation
*“The advent of the automobile may have altered the growth pattern of the city”*
*“The discussion has changed my thinking about the issue”*
2. **變, 變化, 改變** — become different in some particular way, without permanently losing one's or its former characteristics or essence
*“her mood changes in accordance with the weather”*
*“The supermarket's selection of vegetables varies according to the season”*
3. **換, 移轉, 轉換, 轉移, 更換** — lay aside, abandon, or leave for another
*“switch to a different brand of beer”*
*“She switched psychiatrists”*
4. **兌換, 更換, 調換, 交換** — give to, and receive from, one another
*“Would you change places with me?”*
*“We have been exchanging letters for a year”*
5. **換乘** — change from one vehicle or transportation line to another
*“She changed in Chicago on her way to the East coast”*
6. *(intransitive)* **變為 /變為, 成為 /成為, 變化 /變化, 改變 /改變, 改為 /改為** — To become something different.
*n.* 1. **修改, 改變, 變化** — an event that occurs when something passes from one state or phase to another
*“the change was intended to increase sales”*
*“this storm is certainly a change for the worse”*
2. **更換** — a relational difference between states; especially between states before and after some event
*“he attributed the change to their marriage”*
3. **零錢** — the balance of money received when the amount you tender is greater than the amount due
*“I paid with a twenty and pocketed the change”*
4. **不同物** — a thing that is different
*“he inspected several changes before selecting one”*
5. **不同的服裝, 新裝** — a different or fresh set of clothes
*“she brought a change in her overnight bag”*
6. *(countable, uncountable)* **變化 /變化** — The process or result of becoming different.

## channel

**發音：** /ˈt͡ʃænəl/
*n.* 1. **溝槽, 溝渠** — a passage for water (or other fluids) to flow through
*“the fields were crossed with irrigation channels”*
*“gutters carried off the rainwater into a series of channels under the street”*
2. **水道, 運河 /運河** — The natural or man-made deeper course through a reef, bar, bay, or any shallow body of water.
3. **水渠, 航路** — The navigable part of a river.
4. **凹槽, 溝** — a long narrow furrow cut either by a natural process (such as erosion) or by a tool (as e.g. a groove in a phonograph record)

6. **深水航道** — a deep and relatively narrow body of water (as in a river or a harbor or a strait linking two larger bodies) that allows the best passage for vessels
*“the ship went aground in the channel”*
*v.* 1. **傳導, 傳遞, 轉達, 輸送, 傳達** — transmit or serve as the medium for transmission
*“Sound carries well over water”*
*“The airwaves carry the sound”*

3. **導流, 引導** — direct the flow of
*“channel information towards a broad audience”*
4. **輸送, 傳送, 傳遞** — send from one person or place to another
*“transmit a message”*

## charge

*v.* 1. **要求支付, 收費** — demand payment
*“Will I get charged for this service?”*

*“The car tore down the street”*
*“He came charging into my office”*
3. **委派, 分派, 指派** — assign a duty, responsibility or obligation to
*“He was appointed deputy manager”*
*“She was charged with supervising the creation of a concordance”*
4. **指控** — make an accusatory claim
*“The defense attorney charged that the jurors were biased”*
5. **收費** — enter a certain amount as a charge
*“he charged me $15”*
6. *(transitive)* **控告** — To formally accuse (a person) of a crime.
*n.* 1. **費用** — the price charged for some article or service
*“the admission charge”*

*“the battery needed a fresh charge”*
3. **控告, 控訴, 譴責, 指控, 指責** — an assertion that someone is guilty of a fault or offence
*“the newspaper published charges that Jones was guilty of drunken driving”*
4. *(countable, uncountable)* **費用 /費用, 收費 /收費** — The amount of money levied for a service.
5. *(countable, uncountable)* **衝 /衝** — A forceful forward movement.
6. *(countable, uncountable)* **電荷 /電荷** — An electric charge.

## civil

2. **民事+的, 民間+的** — of or occurring within the state or between or among citizens of the state
*“civil affairs”*
*“civil strife”*
3. **公民+的, 市民+的, 平民+的, 民事+的** — of or relating to or befitting citizens as individuals

*“civil peoples”*
5. applying to ordinary citizens as contrasted with the military
*“civil authorities”*

## claim

**發音：** /kleɪm/
*v.* 1. **主張, 聲稱** — assert or affirm strongly; state to be true or existing
*“He claimed that he killed the burglar”*
2. **認領** — demand as being one's due or property; assert one's right or title to
*“He claimed his suitcases at the airline counter”*
*“Mr. Smith claims special tax exemptions because he is a foreign resident”*
3. **聲稱 /聲稱, 宣稱 /宣稱** — To state a new fact, typically without providing evidence to prove it is true.
4. **索賠 /索賠** — To demand compensation or damages through the courts.
5. ask for legally or make a legal claim to, as of debts, for example
*“They claimed on the maximum allowable amount”*
6. lay claim to; as of an idea
*“She took credit for the whole idea”*
*n.* 1. **聲稱, 斷言** — an assertion that something is true or factual
*“his claim that he was innocent”*
*“evidence contradicted the government's claims”*
2. **聲稱, 要求** — demand for something as rightful or due
*“they struck in support of their claim for a shorter work day”*
3. **所有權, 權利** — an established or recognized right
*“a strong legal claim to the property”*
*“he had no documents confirming his title to his father's estate”*
4. **主張 /主張** — A new statement of something one believes to be the truth, usually when the statement has yet to be verified or without valid evidence provided.
5. **索賠 /索賠** — A legal demand for compensation or damages.
6. an assertion of a right (as to money or property)
*“his claim asked for damages”*

**發音：** /ˈklɪə/

*“a clear conscience”*
*“regarded her questioner with clear untroubled eyes”*

5. **散去, 消散, 消失** — go away or disappear

## cloud

*n.* 1. **雲** — a visible mass of water or ice particles suspended at a considerable altitude
2. **模糊, 不真實** — out of touch with reality
*“his head was in the clouds”*
3. **憂色** — a cause of worry or gloom or trouble
*“the only cloud on the horizon was the possibility of dissent by the French”*
4. **疑雲** — suspicion affecting your reputation
*“after that mistake he was under a cloud”*
5. any collection of particles (e.g., smoke or dust) or gases that is visible
6. a group of many things in the air or on the ground
*“a swarm of insects obscured the light”*
*“clouds of blossoms”*
*v.* 1. **使多雲, 使陰, 使陰暗, 使黯然** — make overcast or cloudy
*“Fall weather often overcasts our beaches”*
2. **使含糊, 使看不清, 遮掩, 使困惑** — make less visible or unclear
*“The stars are obscured by the clouds”*
*“the big elm tree obscures our view of the valley”*
3. **變得多雲, 陰雲密佈** — billow up in the form of a cloud
*“The smoke clouded above the houses”*
4. **使昏暗, 使暗淡, 變渾濁, 使模糊** — make milky or dull
*“The chemical clouded the liquid to which it was added”*
5. make gloomy or depressed
*“Their faces were clouded with sadness”*
6. place under suspicion or cast doubt upon
*“sully someone's reputation”*

## cloud chamber

*n.* 1. **雲室 /雲室** — A particle detector used for detecting ionizing radiation. In its most basic form, it is a sealed environment containing a supersaturated vapor of water or alcohol, in which a mist can be seen where a charged particle interacts with the mixture and it ionizes it.
2. **雲室, 威爾遜雲室** — apparatus that detects the path of high-energy particles passing through a supersaturated vapor; each particle ionizes molecules along its path and small droplets condense on them to produce a visible track

*n.* 1. **編碼** — (computer science) the symbolic arrangement of data or instructions in a computer program or the set of such instructions
2. *(countable, uncountable)* **代碼 /代碼** — A short textual designation, often with little relation to the item it represents.
3. *(countable, uncountable)* **法規 /法規** — A body of law, sanctioned by legislation, in which the rules of law to be specifically applied by the courts are set forth in systematic form; a compilation of laws by public authority; a digest.
4. *(countable, uncountable)* **規章 /規章, 法典, 章程, 準則 /準則** — Any system of principles, rules or regulations relating to one subject.
5. *(countable, uncountable)* **代碼 /代碼, 密碼 /密碼** — A cryptographic system using a codebook that converts words or phrases into codewords.
6. *(uncountable)* **碼 /碼, 代碼 /代碼** — Instructions for a computer, written in a programming language; the input of a translator, an interpreter or a browser, namely: source code, machine code, bytecode.
*v.* 1. **編碼** — To encode.
2. **編程 /編程** — To write software programs.
3. attach a code to
*“Code the pieces with numbers so that you can identify them later”*
4. convert ordinary language into code
*“We should encode the message for security reasons”*

<a id="entry-c-005052"></a>
## code monkey

*n.* 1. *(derogatory, slang, sometimes)* **程序猿, 碼農 /碼農** — A computer programmer.

<a id="entry-c-005053"></a>
## code name

*n.* 1. **代號 /代號** — A name used to clandestinely identify somebody or something, either for military or espionage purposes, or for commercial confidentiality.

<a id="entry-c-005054"></a>
## code of conduct

*n.* 1. **行為準則 /行為準則, 行為守則 /行為守則, 行動規範 /行動規範, 條例 /條例** — A set of rules dictating acceptable behavior and decisions in a specified environment.
2. a set of conventional principles and expectations that are considered binding on any person who is a member of a particular group

<a id="entry-c-005055"></a>
## code point

*n.* 1. **碼點 /碼點** — A numerical offset in a character set, etc., as opposed to a displayed grapheme or character, which can be composed of several code points.

<a id="entry-c-005056"></a>

*n.* 1. *(countable, uncountable)* **語碼轉換 /語碼轉換** — The phenomenon or practice of alternating between two or more languages or language varieties.

<a id="entry-c-005057"></a>
## codebase

*n.* 1. **代碼庫 /代碼庫** — The body of source code used to create a particular computer program or software component.

**發音：** /ˈkəʊ.diːn/

2. **可待因** — derivative of opium; used as an antitussive (to relieve coughing) and an analgesic (to relieve pain)

3. a set of rules or principles or laws (especially written ones)

<a id="entry-c-005073"></a>
## coefficient

**發音：** [ˌkəʊ.ɪˈfɪʃn̩t]
*n.* 1. **率, 係數** — a constant number that serves as a measure of some property or characteristic
2. **係數 /係數** — A constant by which an algebraic term is multiplied.
3. **係數 /係數** — A number, value, or item that serves as a measure of some property or characteristic.

<a id="entry-c-005074"></a>
## coefficient of absorption

*n.* 1. **吸收比, 吸收係數** — a measure of the rate of decrease in the intensity of electromagnetic radiation (as light) as it passes through a given substance; the fraction of incident radiant energy absorbed per unit mass or thickness of an absorber
*“absorptance equals 1 minus transmittance”*

<a id="entry-c-005075"></a>
## coefficient of drag

*n.* 1. **拖拽係數, 牽引係數, 阻力系數** — the ratio of the drag on a body moving through air to the product of the velocity and the surface area of the body

<a id="entry-c-005076"></a>
## coefficient of elasticity

*n.* 1. **彈性係數** — (physics) the ratio of the applied stress to the change in shape of an elastic body

<a id="entry-c-005077"></a>
## coefficient of expansion

*n.* 1. **膨脹係數** — the fractional change in length or area or volume per unit change in temperature at a given constant pressure

<a id="entry-c-005078"></a>
## coefficient of friction

*n.* 1. **摩擦係數 /摩擦係數** — The ratio between (1) the magnitude of the force of friction which a surface produces on an object (moving along the surface or being pressed statically against it) and (2) the magnitude of the normal force which is produced by the surface on the object and which is perpendicular to that surface.
2. **摩擦係數** — the ratio of the weight of an object being moved along a surface and the force that maintains contact between the object and the surface

<a id="entry-c-005079"></a>
## coefficient of mutual induction

*n.* 1. **電感係數** — a measure of the induction between two circuits; the ratio of the electromotive force in a circuit to the corresponding change of current in a neighboring circuit; usually measured in henries

<a id="entry-c-005080"></a>
## coefficient of reflection

*n.* 1. **反射比, 反射率** — the fraction of radiant energy that is reflected from a surface

<a id="entry-c-005081"></a>
## coefficient of self induction

*n.* 1. **自感, 自感係數** — the ratio of the electromotive force produced in a circuit by self-induction to the rate of change of current producing it, expressed in henries

<a id="entry-c-005082"></a>
## coefficient of viscosity

*n.* 1. **動態粘滯度, 粘滯係數** — a measure of the resistance to flow of a fluid under an applied force

## coelacanth

**發音：** /ˈsiː.lə.kænθ/
*n.* 1. **矛尾魚 /矛尾魚** — Any of the class Actinistia of primitive lobe-finned fish in the order Coelacanthiformes—thought to have been extinct for 70 million years until a living specimen was discovered in 1938. Most species are large and plump and they all have bodies covered in tough elasmoid scales that act as armor.
2. **矛尾魚, 腔棘魚** — fish thought to have been extinct since the Cretaceous period but found in 1938 off the coast of Africa

## coerce

**發音：** /kəʊˈɜːs/

2. *(transitive)* **強行制止 /強行制止, 強制 /強制, 約束 /約束** — To restrain by force, especially by law or authority; to repress; to curb.

4. *(transitive)* **強迫轉型 /強迫轉型** — To force an attribute, normally of a data type, to take on the attribute of another data type.

## cold

*adj.* 1. **冷, 涼+的, 寒, 氣溫低+的, 溫度不足+的** — having a low or inadequate temperature or feeling a sensation of coldness or having been made cold by e.g. ice or refrigeration

5. marked by errorless familiarity
*“had her lines cold before rehearsals started”*
6. lacking originality or spontaneity; no longer new
*“moth-eaten theories about race”*
*“stale news”*
*n.* 1. **傷風, 感冒** — a mild viral infection involving the nose and respiratory passages (but not the lungs)

*“the coldness made our breath visible”*
*“come in out of the cold”*

*“he shivered from the cold”*
*“the cold helped clear his head”*

## color

*n.* 1. **顏料, 著色劑, 色料** — any material used for its color
*“she used a different color for the trim”*
2. **色, 色彩, 顏色** — the appearance of objects (or light sources) described in terms of a person's perception of their hue and lightness (or brightness) and saturation
3. a visual attribute of things that results from the light they emit or transmit or reflect
*“a white color is made up of many different wavelengths of light”*
4. interest and variety and intensity
*“the Puritan Period was lacking in color”*
*“the characters were delineated with exceptional vividness”*
5. the timbre of a musical sound
*“the recording fails to capture the true color of the original music”*
6. a race with skin pigmentation different from the white race (especially Blacks)
*adj.* 1. **彩色+的** — having or capable of producing colors
*“color film”*
*“he rented a color television”*
*v.* 1. **歪曲, 粉飾** — modify or bias
*“His political ideas color his lectures”*
2. add color to
*“The child colored the drawings”*
*“Fall colored the trees”*
3. affect as in thought or feeling
*“My personal feelings color my judgment in this case”*
*“The sadness tinged his life”*
4. decorate with colors
*“color the walls with paint in warm tones”*
5. give a deceptive explanation or excuse for
*“color a lie”*
6. change color, often in an undesired manner
*“The shirts discolored”*

*“condense the milk”*

## cool

**發音：** /kuːl/
*adj.* 1. **涼快, 涼爽+的** — neither warm nor very cold; giving relief from heat
*“a cool autumn day”*

4. **酷, 平息** — Not showing emotion; calm and in control of oneself.

*“relations were cool and polite”*
*“a cool reception”*
6. **沉著 /沉著** — Unenthusiastic; lukewarm; skeptical.
*v.* 1. **使冷卻, 使涼爽, 使變涼** — make cool or cooler
*“Chill the food”*
2. **變冷, 變涼, 冷卻** — loose heat
*“The air cooled considerably after the thunderstorm”*

4. **冷卻, 冷靜下來, 平息下來, 冷靜, 變涼** — lose intensity
*“His enthusiasm cooled considerably”*
*n.* 1. the quality of being at a refreshingly low temperature
*“the cool of early morning”*

*“keep your cool”*

2. **剽竊 /剽竊** — An imitation, sometimes of inferior quality.
3. a reproduction of a written record (e.g. of a legal or school record)
4. matter to be printed; exclusive of graphical materials
5. material suitable for a journalistic account
*“catastrophes make good copy”*
*v.* 1. **學樣, 摹擬, 效法, 仿效, 模仿** — reproduce someone's behavior or looks
*“The mime imitated the passers-by”*
*“Children often copy their parents or older siblings”*
2. *(transitive)* **複製 /複製** — To produce an object identical to a given object.
3. **臨摹, 複製** — make a replica of
*“copy that drawing”*
*“re-create a picture by Rembrandt”*
4. **收到, 抄收** — To receive a transmission successfully.
5. copy down as is
*“The students were made to copy the alphabet over and over”*
6. reproduce or make an exact copy of
*“replicate the cell”*
*“copy the genetic information”*

## corrupt

*adj.* 1. **邪惡+的, 腐敗+的** — not straight; dishonest or immoral or evasive

*“humanity they knew to be corrupt...from the day of Adam's creation”*

3. containing errors or alterations
*“a corrupt text”*
*“spoke a corrupted version of the language”*
4. touched by rot or decay
*“tainted bacon”*
*“`corrupt' is archaic”*
*v.* 1. **使墮落, 使惡化, 使腐敗, 使道德敗壞** — corrupt morally or by intemperance or sensuality
*“debauch the young people with wine and women”*
*“Socrates was accused of corrupting young men”*
2. **行賄, 收買, 賄賂** — make illegal payments to in exchange for favors or influence
*“This judge can be bought”*
3. place under suspicion or cast doubt upon
*“sully someone's reputation”*
4. alter from the original

*adj.* 1. **宇宙論+的, 宇宙哲學+的** — pertaining to the branch of astronomy dealing with the origin and history and structure and dynamics of the universe
*“cosmologic science”*
*“cosmological redshift”*
2. **宇宙哲學+的, 宇宙論+的** — pertaining to the branch of philosophy dealing with the elements and laws and especially the characteristics of the universe such as space and time and causality
*“cosmologic philosophy”*
*“a cosmological argument is an argument that the universe demands the admission of an adequate external cause which is God”*

<a id="entry-c-007387"></a>

## cosmopolitan

**發音：** /ˌkɒz.məˈpɒl.ɪ.tən/
*n.* 1. a sophisticated person who has travelled in many countries
*adj.* 1. **大都會的, 世界性的** — Composed of people from all over the world.
2. **四海為家的** — At ease in any part of the world; having a wide experience with many cultures.
3. **全世界+的, 全球+的, 國際+的, 普遍+的** — of worldwide scope or applicability
*“an issue of cosmopolitan import”*
*“the shrewdest political and ecumenical comment of our time"- Christopher Morley”*
4. growing or occurring in many parts of the world
*“a cosmopolitan herb”*
*“cosmopolitan in distribution”*
5. composed of people from or at home in many parts of the world; especially not provincial in attitudes or interests
*“his cosmopolitan benevolence impartially extended to all races and to all creeds"- T.B. Macaulay”*
*“the ancient and cosmopolitan societies of Syria and Egypt”*

## cost

**發音：** /kɒst/
*n.* 1. **成本, 支出, 代價, 花費** — the total spent for goods or services including money and time and labor
2. **價格, 幣值, 價錢, 價值** — the property of having material worth (often indicated by the amount of money something would bring if sold)
*“the fluctuating monetary value of gold and silver”*
*“he puts a high price on his services”*
3. **代價, 成本, 價值, 價格** — value measured by what must be given or done or undergone to obtain something
*“the cost in human life was enormous”*
*“the price of success is hard work”*
4. *(countable, uncountable)* **費用 /費用, 成本, 花費 /花費** — Amount of money, time, etc. that is required or used.
*v.* 1. **價格為, 值, 花費, 價值** — be priced at
*“These shoes cost $100”*
2. **失去, 花費** — require to lose, suffer, or sacrifice
*“This mistake cost him his job”*
3. *(ditransitive, transitive)* **花費 /花費** — To incur a charge of; to require payment of a (specified) price.

## cover

**發音：** /ˈkʌvɚ/
*v.* 1. **蓋, 遮蓋, 覆蓋** — provide with a covering or cause to be covered
*“cover her face with a handkerchief”*
*“cover the child with a blanket”*
2. **延伸, 延續** — span an interval of distance, space or time
*“The war extended over five years”*
*“The period covered the turn of the century”*
3. **負擔支付, 包括** — provide for
*“The grant doesn't cover my salary”*
4. **論述, 涉及, 對付** — act on verbally or in some form of artistic expression
*“This book deals with incest”*
*“The course covered all of Western Civilization”*
5. **包含, 包括** — include in scope; include as part of something broader; have as one's sphere or territory
*“This group encompasses a wide range of people from different backgrounds”*
*“this should cover everyone in the group”*
6. **庇護, 掩護, 保護** — to take an action to protect against future problems
*“Count the cash in the drawer twice just to cover yourself”*
*n.* 1. **掩蔽物** — a covering that serves to conceal or shelter something
*“a screen of trees afforded privacy”*
*“under cover of darkness”*
2. **毛毯, 毯, 毯子** — bedding that keeps a person warm in bed
*“he pulled the covers over his head and went to sleep”*
3. **封面** — the protective covering on the front, back, and spine of a book
*“the book had a leather binding”*

5. *(countable, uncountable)* **蓋子 /蓋子, 蓋 /蓋, 罩** — A lid.
6. *(countable, uncountable)* **床罩** — The top sheet of a bed.
*adj.* 1. *(not-comparable)* **封面** — Of or pertaining to the front cover of a book or magazine.

**發音：** /kjuːb/
*n.* 1. **正立方形, 立方體** — a hexahedron with six equal squares as faces
2. **方塊, 立方體** — a three-dimensional shape with six square or rectangular sides
3. **立方** — The third power of a number, value, term or expression.
4. **3次冪, 三次冪, 立方** — the product of three equal terms
5. **立方體 /立方體** — A regular polyhedron having six identical square faces.
6. **方塊 /方塊** — Any object more or less in the form of a cube.
*v.* 1. *(transitive)* **三次方** — To raise to the third power; to determine the result of multiplying by itself twice.
2. *(transitive)* **形成立方體 /形成立方體** — To form into the shape of a cube.
3. *(transitive)* **切成方塊 /切成方塊** — To cut into cubes.
4. raise to the third power
5. cut into cubes
*“cube the cheese”*

## cycle

**發音：** /ˈsaɪ.kəl/

*“a cycle of reprisal and retaliation”*

4. **週期** — A complete rotation of anything.
5. **單車, 腳踏車, 自行車** — a wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals
6. a series of poems or songs on the same theme
*“Schubert's song cycles”*
*v.* 1. **使循環, 使輪轉, 循環** — cause to go through a recurring sequence
*“cycle the laundry in this washing program”*
2. **輪轉** — pass through a cycle
*“This machine automatically cycles”*
3. **週期, 循環** — recur in repeating sequences
4. **騎車 /騎車, 騎自行車 /騎自行車** — To ride a bicycle or other cycle.

6. **騎自行車, 騎車** — ride a bicycle
